title: Pagination renders ALL page number buttons at once — 20+ pages renders 20+ DOM buttons
detail: Lines 113-127: pagination loop renders one button per page. At PAGE_SIZE=50, a 1000-contract dataset means 20 page buttons. Windowed pagination is the standard UX pattern.
evidence: ViewSmartList.jsx:114-127 — for loop from 1 to totalPages.
recommendedFix: Render a windowed subset: current page +/- 2, with ellipsis for gaps.

title: Expandable table rows use onClick but no keyboard interaction — cannot expand with Enter/Space
detail: Lines 86-100: each contract row has onClick but no tabIndex, onKeyDown, role='button', or aria-expanded. Keyboard-only users cannot tab to a row or expand it.
evidence: ViewSmartList.jsx:86-100 — tr has onClick but no tabIndex or onKeyDown. Same issue: ViewCustomerGroups.jsx:73.
recommendedFix: Add tabIndex={0}, role='button', aria-expanded={isOpen}, and onKeyDown for Enter/Space.
